headline.en: Pollen Robotics publishes the Microduck 3D model files under a Creative Commons licence they write as 'BY-SA-NC' with NO version number. Their code is Apache 2.0. Their press kit says the hardware is NOT open source. On the plain reading of CC BY-NC-SA, geometry taken from those files may be reproduced and built for NON-commercial purposes only, and anything derived from it that is shared must carry the same licence. Selling units made from that geometry is NOT permitted by the published licence. A commercial licence from Pollen, or a counsel opinion that the manufactured parts are not 'Adapted Material' of a copyright work, is what would change that. Neither exists tonight.
headline.zh: Pollen Robotics 以其写作 'BY-SA-NC'、未注明版本号的知识共享许可证发布 Microduck 3D 模型文件。其代码为 Apache 2.0。其新闻资料明确说明硬件不是开源的。按 CC BY-NC-SA 的字面含义，取自这些文件的几何体只能用于非商业目的的复制和制作，任何由此派生并分享的内容必须采用相同许可证。以该几何体制造的整机不允许销售。能改变这一点的只有 Pollen 出具的商业许可，或律师出具的意见书认定所制造的零件不属于受版权保护作品的'演绎材料'。今晚这两者都不存在。

reading: Open Duck Mini v2 is Apache-2.0 for the whole repository: code, print/*.stl and docs. Its README carves out nothing; there is no NC clause on Open Duck Mini.

Its CAD lives in a public Onshape document. Onshape public documents carry no licence statement of their own; the repository licence is the only written term (CANNOT DETERMINE whether Apache-2.0 was intended to reach the Onshape model — the README does not say).

NONE of our geometry comes from Open Duck Mini. Every mesh on our shelf is mapped to pollen-robotics/microduck_rl assets (spec/mesh-to-part.json). Open Duck Mini's licence therefore does not govern our parts; it is context, not a source.

Pollen's own Microduck pages never mention Open Duck Mini (research/01-product-and-specs.md:355, checked against the product page, press kit and blog). The lineage is asserted by press and community, and by the shared author (Antoine Pirrone), not by Pollen.

Open Duck Mini describes itself as 'a miniature version of the BDX Droid by Disney'. Whether any character/design right of Disney reaches the Microduck shape is a counsel question; it is outside every licence quoted here.
facts.verdict_note: Licence fact established (Apache-2.0). Geometry lineage into Microduck: CANNOT DETERMINE and immaterial to our position, because no ODM file is on our shelf.

facts.cc_faq_quote: CC's NonCommercial (NC) licenses prohibit uses that are "primarily intended for or directed toward commercial advantage or monetary compensation." [...] Please note that CC's definition does not turn on the type of user: if you are a nonprofit or charitable organization, your use of an NC-licensed work could still run afoul of the NC restriction, and if you are a for-profit entity, your use of an NC-licensed work does not necessarily mean you have violated the term. facts.cc_faq_source: https://creativecommons.org/faq/ , 'Does my use violate the NonCommercial clause of the licenses?', fetched 2026-09-03T15:18:05Z
reading: The licence is a COPYRIGHT licence (1(a): 'material subject to Copyright and Similar Rights'). It only reaches what copyright reaches. Whether the functional shape of a servo bracket is protected by copyright, and in which country, is not answered by the licence text. That is the single question counsel must answer (Q-B).
The grant (2(a)(1)) covers reproducing the files and producing Adapted Material — including, on the plain reading, physical objects made from them — for NonCommercial purposes ONLY.

ShareAlike (3(b)) binds anything we SHARE that is Adapted Material: drawings, rebuilt CAD, STEP files we hand to a factory, if they are Adapted Material, must go out under BY-NC-SA with attribution (3(a)).
Nothing in the licence is a volume threshold, a royalty schedule or a per-unit fee; NC is a purpose test.

facts.topic: Trade names and design rights — outside every licence above
facts.topic_zh: 商标名称与外观设计权——不在上述任何许可证之内
reading: 'Microduck' and 'Pollen Robotics' are trade names. Apache 2.0 section 6 and CC 2(b)(2) both exclude trademark rights. A unit we make cannot be sold under the name Microduck on the strength of any licence quoted here.

Whether 'Microduck' is a registered mark, in which classes and territories (EU, US, CN), was NOT searched tonight. What settles it: an EUIPO eSearch, USPTO TESS and CNIPA query for the word mark, done by counsel or by Leif.

The product's appearance was first disclosed publicly on 2026-08-27 (press kit, The Register). In the EU an unregistered Community design arises on first disclosure and runs three years against copying (Regulation (EC) No 6/2002, Article 11). Whether Pollen has filed registered designs or design patents (EU RCD, CN 外观设计专利, US design patent) is CANNOT DETERMINE; what settles it: a DesignView / CNIPA / USPTO design search. This is independent of copyright and of the CC licence.
Patents: CC 2(b)(2) licenses no patents; Apache 2.0 section 3 licenses the contributors' patents for the software only. No patent search was done.
facts.settles_it: Trademark, registered-design and design-patent searches in EU, US and CN — a half-day for counsel or a paralegal; the queries are named above.

questions.q_en: May we manufacture units from geometry derived from these assets?
questions.q_zh: 我们可以用源自这些资产的几何体制造整机吗？
questions.verdict: PASS for non-commercial engineering units; FAIL for production units intended for sale
questions.plain_reading: CC 2(a)(1)(b) grants the right to 'produce, reproduce, and Share Adapted Material for NonCommercial purposes only'. Building prototype and validation units for our own engineering, not sold, not offered, is within the grant provided attribution (3(a)) is kept on anything shared. A production run whose purpose is sale is 'primarily intended for or directed towards commercial advantage' (1(k)) and is outside the grant.
questions.what_the_factory_may_do_now: Print, machine and assemble engineering units from our drawings for test and validation; keep Pollen's attribution on every file; share nothing derived from the meshes outside the project except under BY-NC-SA.
questions.what_the_factory_may_not_do_now: Cut production tooling (moulds) whose purpose is units for sale, on the strength of this licence alone.
questions.settles_it: Q-A (a licence from Pollen) or Q-B (counsel: the parts are not Adapted Material of a copyright work).

questions.q_zh: 我们可以销售这些整机吗？
questions.plain_reading: Selling a unit is monetary compensation for an object produced from the Licensed Material. 2(a)(1) limits every licensed right to NonCommercial purposes. There is no clause that permits sale, and 6(a) terminates the licence automatically on breach. Pollen has also said the hardware is not open (F4) and sells the same product at USD 399.00 (F8).
questions.settles_it: Q-A or Q-B. Nothing we can do inside the repository changes this answer.

questions.q_en: May we sell commercially at volume, given the non-commercial clause?
questions.q_zh: 鉴于非商业条款，我们可以大批量商业销售吗？
questions.verdict: FAIL on the published licence — volume does not change it
questions.plain_reading: The NC clause (1(k)) is a purpose test with no quantity threshold: one unit sold and ten thousand units sold are both 'directed towards commercial advantage'. CC's FAQ says whether a use is commercial 'will depend on the specifics of the situation and the intentions of the user'; the intention here — a factory, tooling, a price list — is commercial on its face.
questions.settles_it: Q-A or Q-B. Note that Q-B, if it lands in our favour, answers only copyright; F9 (trade names, unregistered EU design right from 2026-08-27, any registered designs or patents) is a separate gate on the same sale.

en: Keep the attribution 'Pollen Robotics — microduck_rl, CC BY-NC-SA, https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck_rl' on every drawing, STEP and print file you receive from us that carries geometry of a vendor-origin or rebuilt part. Do not remove it.
Do not upload, resell or share those files outside this project. If you must share them (with a sub-supplier), share them under the same licence and with the same attribution.
Engineering and validation units: go ahead. Production tooling for units to be sold: wait for Q-A or Q-B to close. We will write the answer into this page.
Our PCB designs, harness, jigs, test procedures and documents are ours; their licence to you is set by our contract, not by Pollen's licence.
Do not use the name 'Microduck' or 'Pollen Robotics' on any part, box, label or listing.
zh: 在我们交付的每一张图纸、每个 STEP 和打印文件上，凡包含供应商来源或重建零件几何体的，保留署名'Pollen Robotics — microduck_rl, CC BY-NC-SA, https://github.com/pollen-robotics/microduck_rl'。不要删除。
不要在本项目之外上传、转售或分享这些文件。如必须分享（给分包商），须采用相同许可证并保留相同署名。
工程样机与验证样机：可以进行。用于销售整机的量产模具：等待 Q-A 或 Q-B 关闭。答案会写入本页。
我们的 PCB 设计、线束、工装、测试程序和文档归我们所有；对贵方的授权由我们的合同规定，而非 Pollen 的许可证。
不要在任何零件、包装、标签或商品列表上使用'Microduck'或'Pollen Robotics'名称。
